run_cifar10_training: run the CIFAR-10 CNN training script with configurable epochs and learning rate via CLI flags
build_cnn_model: build a sequential CNN model with Conv2D, MaxPooling2D, Flatten, and Dense layers for image classification
load_cifar10_dataset: load and normalize the CIFAR-10 dataset using tensorflow.keras.datasets.cifar10
train_with_distributed_strategy: train the model using tf.distribute.MirroredStrategy for multi-GPU distributed training
configure_tensorboard_callbacks: configure TensorBoard callbacks for training metrics logging with histogram frequency
